mostWorthwhile.text: The grazing impact and subsequent moon formation were most worthwhile: the moon came from debris around the same world I had followed.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding metal-rich fragments was less compelling as a choice because I wasn't sure how it related to the moon goal, although the core formation made sense afterward.

surprise.text: The first large impact melted the world's interior rather than immediately producing moon-forming debris.

arbitrary.text: The metal-rich fragments had an unclear purpose when I chose them; their role in forming a dense core became clear in the result.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to follow the rubble world and remaining fragments, though the offered compatible combinations leave less room for discovery.
